tasks.title: Scaffold monorepo & tooling
tasks.description: Set up the monorepo structure with apps/platform (Next.js 15), apps/connector (Node/TypeScript), and packages/shared, plus base tooling.
tasks.details: Use pnpm workspaces. apps/platform: Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui initialized, ESLint + Prettier configured. apps/connector: minimal Node + TypeScript service skeleton with tsx for dev. packages/shared: TypeScript package for Zod schemas and shared types consumed by both apps. Add root scripts (dev, build, lint, test) and a README describing the layout. Do not implement features yet.
tasks.testStrategy: pnpm install and pnpm build succeed for all workspaces; dev servers start without errors; lint passes on the scaffold.

tasks.title: Database schema & Prisma setup
tasks.description: Define the Postgres schema via Prisma: users, overlays, connections, events, and run initial migrations.
tasks.details: Prisma schema: users (id, email unique, passwordHash, name, timestamps); overlays (id, userId FK, name, sceneJson jsonb, publicToken unique indexed, timestamps); connections (id, userId FK, platform enum default 'tiktok', username, status enum: disconnected/connecting/live/error, timestamps); events (id, connectionId FK, type enum: gift/chat/follow, payload jsonb, createdAt indexed). Add Prisma client generation in packages/shared or a dedicated db package. Provide docker-compose for local Postgres and Redis.
tasks.testStrategy: prisma migrate dev runs clean; integration test creates a user + overlay + connection row and reads them back; unique constraints enforced (duplicate email/publicToken rejected).

tasks.title: Authentication & dashboard shell
tasks.description: Email+password auth (register, login, logout) with secure sessions and a dashboard shell listing overlays.
tasks.details: Use Auth.js (NextAuth) credentials provider or iron-session with bcrypt password hashing; httpOnly secure cookies. Pages: /register, /login, /dashboard. Dashboard shows the user's overlays (empty state + create button) and TikTok connection status placeholder. Middleware protects /dashboard and /editor routes. Input validation with Zod; proper error messages.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests: register → login → access dashboard; wrong password rejected; unauthenticated access to /dashboard redirects to /login; logout clears session.

tasks.title: Scene JSON schema & overlay CRUD API
tasks.description: Define the Zod scene schema in packages/shared and implement overlays CRUD REST API with ownership checks.
tasks.details: Zod schema: { canvas: {width:1920, height:1080}, layers: [{id uuid, type: 'gift-alert'|'chat'|'leaderboard'|'game-canvas'|'goal'|'text'|'image', x, y, width, height, rotation, opacity 0-1, zIndex, config: discriminated per type}] }. API routes: POST /api/overlays, GET /api/overlays (list own), GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/overlays/:id, all authenticated and scoped to owner. Generate publicToken (crypto random, URL-safe) on create. Standardized error responses with correct HTTP codes.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for Zod schema (valid scene passes, bad type/coords rejected). Integration tests: CRUD lifecycle, 401 unauthenticated, 403 other user's overlay, PATCH persists sceneJson.

tasks.title: Shared widget components (renderer library)
tasks.description: Build the 6 React widget components that render from scene JSON config, used identically by the editor and the overlay runtime.
tasks.details: In packages/shared (or apps/platform components lib): WidgetRenderer switch by layer.type. Widgets: GiftAlert (animated alert, config: text template, duration, sound), ChatBox (styled message list, subscribes to event feed via props/context), Leaderboard (top gifters list from event feed), GoalCounter (progress bar with target), Text (styled text), Image (src, fit). GameCanvas renders an iframe/URL placeholder for connector game renderers. Each widget is pure/presentational: receives config + event stream via a React context (EventFeedProvider) so the editor can show static/sample data and the runtime real data. Deterministic sample event generator for previews.
tasks.testStrategy: Storybook-style render tests or React Testing Library: each widget renders from a sample scene config; GiftAlert animates on simulated gift event; Leaderboard orders by amount.

tasks.title: Drag-and-drop overlay editor
tasks.description: The flagship editor: 1920x1080 canvas, widget palette, inspector, layer list, drag/resize/rotate, undo/redo, autosave.
tasks.details: Route /editor/[overlayId]. Layout: left palette (6 widget types, drag onto canvas), center canvas with zoom/pan (fit-to-screen default), right inspector (position/size/rotation/opacity + per-widget config forms), bottom layer list (zIndex order, visibility, lock, select). Use dnd-kit for palette→canvas drag and react-rnd for move/resize/rotate on selected layers. Grid + snapping (8px). Undo/redo via command pattern (serialize inverse ops). Autosave debounced 1s via PATCH; save status indicator. Multi-select basics (shift-click, group move). Widgets render via shared WidgetRenderer at canvas scale.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for undo/redo reducer. E2E (Playwright): create overlay → drag Text widget onto canvas → move/resize → save → reload page → layout persists identically.

tasks.title: Overlay runtime + WebSocket hub
tasks.description: Public /overlay/[token] browser-source page rendering the scene live, with socket.io WebSocket hub on a custom Next.js server.
tasks.details: Custom server.ts wrapping Next.js with socket.io. /overlay/[token] (no auth, token from overlay.publicToken) renders the scene full-screen at native 1920x1080 with WidgetRenderer — same components as editor (WYSIWYG parity). Client joins room `overlay:{overlayId}`; hub relays normalized events {type, user, amount, data} to the room. EventFeedProvider feeds widgets. Cache overlay scene per token with revalidation on save (hub notifies room 'scene-updated' so open overlays hot-reload).
tasks.testStrategy: Integration: opening /overlay/[token] returns scene HTML; socket client in test joins room and receives a broadcast event; scene update triggers scene-updated message.

tasks.title: Connector service: TikTok Live → Redis pub/sub
tasks.description: Evolve tiktok-overlay-connector into apps/connector: join a streamer's TikTok Live, normalize events, publish to Redis.
tasks.details: Port the existing TikTok connection logic from the tiktok-overlay-connector prototype. API: POST /api/connections (username) → service joins Live, status transitions disconnected→connecting→live/error stored on connections row. Normalize events to {type: gift|chat|follow, user, amount, data} and publish to Redis channel `events:{overlayId}`. Include a simulation mode that emits scripted gift/chat events for development and tests (no real TikTok needed). Reconnect/backoff on stream end.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for event normalization (gift with coins → amount, chat → text). Integration: simulation mode publishes to Redis; hub receives and relays to overlay room.

tasks.title: Event-driven widget behavior
tasks.description: Wire Gift Alert, Leaderboard, and Goal/Counter widgets to live WebSocket events end-to-end.
tasks.details: Gift Alert: queue animation per gift (respects duration, plays sound if configured). Leaderboard: aggregate gift amounts per user server-side or client-side over a rolling window, render top N. Goal/Counter: accumulate target metric (e.g., total coins) with progress bar. Chat Box: stream chat messages with max buffer. Ensure overlay filters events by widget types present in scene.
tasks.testStrategy: E2E with simulation mode: emit gift events → alert animates, leaderboard reorders, goal progress increases; all within ~1s; widgets absent from scene do not react.

tasks.title: Testing, polish & E2E flows
tasks.description: Complete test coverage for critical flows, error handling polish, and documentation.
tasks.details: Playwright E2E: register → login → create overlay → edit → save → open /overlay/[token] → simulate gift → verify alert/leaderboard/goal. API error handling audit (400/401/403/404). Lighthouse sanity check on editor and overlay pages. Update README with setup instructions (env vars, docker compose, run commands) and browser-source usage guide.
tasks.testStrategy: CI script runs lint, unit, integration, and E2E suites green; README verified by fresh-clone setup walkthrough.
